episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: Kim's offer of a week full of sex arouses Louie's suspicions of her motives; Louie tries to befriend his neighbor, Walter.

episodes.title: Kim's O
episodes.summary: Having led Kim into uncharted sexual terrain, Louie is asked to rekindle the magic—or face the consequences.

episodes.title: A Mugging Story
episodes.summary: Kim tries to turn the tables on a young mugger, but instead ends up forcing Louie into the role of night watchman.

episodes.title: Long Weekend
episodes.summary: With the Fourth of July approaching, Louie impulsively spends Kim's picnic money on an expensive Frankenstein's monster doll he bought over the internet.

episodes.title: Control
episodes.summary: Concerned about Louie's bad eating habits, Kim puts him on a healthy diet that only aggravates the problem.

episodes.title: Flowers for Kim
episodes.summary: After an argument with Kim, Louie calls his wife a c*nt, leading to an abrupt end to what was supposed to be a sex-filled weekend.

episodes.title: Discipline
episodes.summary: Louie asks for Walter's help in correcting Lucy's rude behaviour.

episodes.title: Get Out
episodes.summary: Tina's rebellious daughter Shannon (Emma Stone) walks out of her mother's life and ends up walking into Louie and Kim's.

episodes.title: Drinking
episodes.summary: After Louie decides to attend a basketball game with Mike and Rich instead of taking care of his sick daughter, he is arrested for DUI.

episodes.title: Confessions
episodes.summary: Forced to go to church after pawning Lucy off on Ellen, Louie finds an unexpected ear for his gripes in the confessional booth.

episodes.title: Louie Quits
episodes.summary: After discovering that the only reason he got a raise in his job (and got hired to begin with) was due to the "charity" of his wife and friends, Louie quits and looks for new work.

episodes.title: Kim Moves Out
episodes.summary: Kim realizes that she hates Louie and decides to move out.

episodes.title: Clowntime is Over
episodes.summary: After Bingo the clown doesn't turn up to Lucy's party, Louie is forced to become "Mr. Pizza Box Man" to the enjoyment of all the children. Other families start contracting his services.
